text.zh-CN:
子宫内膜异位症是类似子宫内膜的组织长在子宫外，常影响盆腔、卵巢和周围器官。

- 这些病灶可引起炎症和瘢痕。痛经、性交痛、排便或排尿痛可能随月经加重，也可能整月存在。
- 有人主要表现为难以怀孕，有人症状很轻；疼痛程度不等于病灶多少。
- 本文讨论异位症。子宫腺肌病发生在子宫肌壁内，是另一种病症，不能把两者当作别名。
text.en:
Endometriosis involves tissue resembling the uterine lining growing outside the uterus, often around the pelvic organs and ovaries.

- The lesions can cause inflammation and scarring. Pain with periods, sex, bowel movements or urination may worsen cyclically or persist throughout the month.
- Some mainly experience difficulty conceiving, while others have few symptoms; pain intensity does not measure the amount of disease.
- This article concerns endometriosis. Adenomyosis affects the uterine muscle wall and is a separate condition, not a synonym.

text.zh-CN:
病因尚未完全明确，不能简单归因于饮食、卫生或个人行为。

- 月经血逆流、细胞变化和免疫调节等是研究中的解释，不代表某一种机制适用于每个人。
- 母亲或姐妹患病会增加发生可能性；较早开始月经、较短周期和较长经期也与风险相关。这些是线索，不是诊断条件。
text.en:
The cause is not fully understood and cannot be reduced to diet, hygiene or personal behavior.

- Backward menstrual flow, cellular changes and altered immune regulation are proposed mechanisms, rather than one explanation established for everyone.
- A mother or sister with the condition increases its likelihood; earlier periods, shorter cycles and longer bleeding are also associated with risk. These are clues, not diagnostic criteria.

text.zh-CN:
出现与以往不同的急性盆腔痛，先按新的急症评估。

- 突然剧烈或迅速加重的下腹痛，尤其伴晕厥、呼吸困难或大量阴道出血，立即到急诊或呼叫当地急救。
- 可能怀孕时出现盆腔痛应尽快获得急诊分流；宫外孕是受精卵在子宫外着床，不能当作普通痛经等待。
- 发热或寒战伴盆腔痛、排尿排便困难，或尿便中见血，当天联系医疗服务。
text.en:
New acute pelvic pain that differs from the usual pattern needs assessment as a new problem.

- Seek emergency care or call local emergency services for sudden severe or rapidly worsening lower abdominal pain, especially with fainting, breathing difficulty or heavy vaginal bleeding.
- Pelvic pain with possible pregnancy needs urgent triage. An ectopic pregnancy develops outside the uterus and must not be dismissed as ordinary period pain.
- Contact medical services the same day for pelvic pain with fever or shivering, difficulty passing urine or stool, or blood in urine or stool.

text.zh-CN:
评估是否就诊要看生活受影响的程度及症状变化。

- 疼痛让你缺课、请假、无法正常活动或影响性生活时，预约妇科或全科评估，不必忍到不能行动。
- 初始止痛或激素治疗无效、不能耐受，或症状反复加重时复诊；涉及肠道、膀胱或卵巢囊肿时可能需要专科团队。
- 准备怀孕或已难以怀孕时，提前说明生育目标，因为抑制排卵的治疗与当前备孕目标不同。
text.en:
The effect on daily life and changes in symptoms help determine when to seek care.

- Arrange primary care or gynecology assessment when pain causes missed school or work, limits activities or affects sex; you need not wait until it is disabling.
- Return if initial pain or hormone treatment fails, is not tolerated or symptoms repeatedly worsen; bowel, bladder or ovarian cyst involvement may require a specialist team.
- Discuss fertility goals when planning or struggling to conceive, because treatments that suppress ovulation do not serve the same purpose as trying for pregnancy now.

text.zh-CN:
医生把病史、查体和适合的检查放在一起判断。

- 记录痛在何处、与月经的关系、出血量及排便排尿症状；医生也会询问家族史和生育计划。内诊需要你的同意。
- 超声可发现卵巢内异囊肿；专业超声或MRI可帮助评估较深的病灶。影像正常仍不能排除浅表病灶。
- 腹腔镜是通过小切口放入镜头查看盆腔，有时同时取样或治疗；不是所有人都必须先做手术才能开始治疗。
text.en:
Diagnosis combines history, examination and appropriate investigations.

- Describe pain location, menstrual timing, bleeding and bowel or bladder symptoms; clinicians also ask about family history and pregnancy plans. An internal examination requires your consent.
- Ultrasound can detect ovarian endometriomas; specialist ultrasound or MRI helps assess deeper disease. Normal imaging does not exclude superficial lesions.
- Laparoscopy uses a camera through small incisions to inspect the pelvis and may allow biopsy or treatment; surgery is not required before treatment in every case.

text.zh-CN:
相似疼痛可能来自不同器官，也可同时存在。

- 腺肌病和子宫肌瘤可造成痛经或大量出血；影像帮助判断病变在子宫肌壁还是其他位置。
- 肠易激综合征也会腹痛、腹胀和排便改变，且可与异位症并存；只看到消化症状不能排除妇科原因。
- 发热或异常分泌物可能提示感染；突发痛、可能怀孕时要优先排除宫外孕、卵巢问题和阑尾炎等。
text.en:
Similar pain can arise from different organs, and more than one condition may coexist.

- Adenomyosis and fibroids may cause painful or heavy periods; imaging helps identify whether abnormalities are within the uterus or elsewhere.
- Irritable bowel syndrome can cause abdominal pain, bloating and bowel changes and can coexist with endometriosis; bowel symptoms alone do not rule out a gynecological cause.
- Fever or unusual discharge may suggest infection; sudden pain or possible pregnancy raises priority for excluding ectopic pregnancy, ovarian problems or appendicitis.

text.zh-CN:
治疗目标包括减痛、恢复生活功能和处理生育困难，方案不只由病灶分期决定。

- 止痛药用于症状，激素治疗用于减少周期相关的刺激和疼痛；是否适合取决于备孕、禁忌和可接受的副作用。
- 手术可去除病灶或囊肿，但可能复发，也可能产生粘连，即器官间形成瘢痕连接；卵巢手术还要讨论保留生育能力。
- 难以怀孕者可能需要生殖专科评估、手术或辅助生殖；妊娠和切除子宫都不能保证治愈异位症。
text.en:
Treatment aims to reduce pain, restore daily functioning and address fertility difficulties; disease stage alone does not choose the plan.

- Pain medicines address symptoms, while hormonal treatment reduces cycle-related stimulation and pain; suitability depends on pregnancy goals, contraindications and tolerable adverse effects.
- Surgery can remove lesions or cysts, but recurrence and adhesions—scar connections between organs—may occur; ovarian surgery also requires discussion of fertility preservation.
- Difficulty conceiving may require fertility assessment, surgery or assisted reproduction; neither pregnancy nor hysterectomy guarantees a cure.

text.zh-CN:
药物作用不同，不能把所有激素或所有止痛药当成同一种治疗。

- 布洛芬等非甾体抗炎药可减痛，但不能去除病灶。胃溃疡、肾病、抗凝药使用或可能怀孕时，先请医生或药师核对。
- 复方避孕药或孕激素可减少疼痛和出血；多数此类方案使用期间避孕，不是提高自然怀孕机会的办法。
- GnRH类药物让卵巢激素暂时下降，可能出现潮热和骨量流失；医生会根据具体药物限制疗程并考虑补充少量激素。各地批准和可及性不同。
text.en:
Medicines have different roles; hormones and painkillers are not interchangeable treatments.

- NSAIDs such as ibuprofen may relieve pain but do not remove lesions. Ask a clinician or pharmacist to check suitability with ulcers, kidney disease, anticoagulants or possible pregnancy.
- Combined hormonal contraceptives or progestogens can reduce pain and bleeding; most such regimens prevent pregnancy during use and do not improve spontaneous conception.
- GnRH medicines temporarily lower ovarian hormones and may cause hot flushes and bone loss; clinicians consider medicine-specific duration limits and hormone add-back. Approval and availability differ by region.

text.zh-CN:
尚没有一种特定饮食被证实能够清除异位病灶。

- 饮食调节若能减轻个人腹胀，可以记录食物、症状和月经时间后与医生讨论；不能把一次改善认定为疾病已消失。
- 草药、维生素或“调激素”补充剂的收益和风险仍不明确；NICE不推荐用中药或补充剂作为已证实的异位症治疗。
- 月经过多伴疲倦时需评估缺铁，饮食问题应围绕实际营养需要处理，不要把所有疲倦都归因于食物。
text.en:
No specific diet has been established as a way to remove endometriosis lesions.

- If dietary changes seem to ease bloating, record food, symptoms and cycle timing for discussion; one improvement does not establish disappearance of disease.
- Benefits and harms of herbal, vitamin or “hormone-balancing” supplements remain uncertain; NICE does not support Chinese herbal medicines or supplements as proven endometriosis treatment.
- Heavy bleeding with fatigue warrants assessment for iron deficiency; nutrition decisions should address actual needs rather than attributing all tiredness to food.

text.zh-CN:
日常记录和疼痛支持有助于说明治疗是否改善了真实生活。

- 记录疼痛天数、出血、漏课漏工、性生活及排便排尿影响，并写下用过的药物和效果，带到复诊。
- 持续疼痛可联合疼痛专科、盆底物理治疗和心理支持；目标是改善活动和应对能力，不是暗示疼痛只是想出来的。
- 新的急性痛、晕厥或大量出血时停止按旧痛经方案自行处理，使用危险信号中的就医路径。
text.en:
Symptom records and pain support help show whether treatment improves real daily life.

- Record pain days, bleeding, missed school or work, effects on sex and bowel or bladder function, and medicines tried with their effects; bring this to review.
- Persistent pain may benefit from pain services, pelvic-floor physiotherapy and psychological support; the goal is better function and coping, not to suggest the pain is imagined.
- For new acute pain, fainting or heavy bleeding, stop relying on an old period-pain plan and follow the urgent-care guidance above.

text.zh-CN:
年龄、器官受累和生育目标会改变评估与治疗选择。

- 青少年也可患病。反复因痛经缺课应评估；不适合或不愿接受经阴道检查时，要讨论其他可接受的检查方式。
- 备孕者与暂不备孕者方案不同；已确诊也不代表一定不孕，应把疼痛控制、年龄及生育计划一起讨论。
- 绝经后通常减轻，但仍可能有症状；新出现的盆腔痛或出血应重新评估，不能直接套用既往诊断。
text.en:
Age, organ involvement and fertility goals change assessment and treatment choices.

- Adolescents can be affected. Repeated school absence from period pain merits assessment; discuss suitable alternatives when vaginal examination or scanning is unacceptable or unsuitable.
- Plans differ for people trying to conceive now and those who are not; a diagnosis does not mean inevitable infertility, so discuss pain, age and reproductive plans together.
- Symptoms often lessen after menopause but can persist; new pelvic pain or bleeding needs reassessment rather than automatic attribution to the old diagnosis.

text.zh-CN:
异位症常需长期管理，改善与复发可能交替出现。

- 复诊应比较疼痛、日常功能、出血和药物副作用，而不只问影像有没有病灶。
- 深部病灶涉及肠道、膀胱或输尿管，或有较大的卵巢内异囊肿时，医生可能安排持续门诊和影像随访。
- 治疗后再次影响工作生活、出现新的排尿排便问题或备孕计划变化时提前复诊。
text.en:
Endometriosis often needs long-term management, with improvement and recurrence over time.

- Follow-up compares pain, everyday functioning, bleeding and adverse effects, rather than looking only for lesions on imaging.
- Deep disease involving the bowel, bladder or ureter, or a larger ovarian endometrioma, may require ongoing outpatient and imaging follow-up.
- Seek earlier review when symptoms again disrupt daily life, new urinary or bowel problems arise, or pregnancy plans change.

text.zh-CN:
主要负担来自疼痛、局部瘢痕及生育影响，发生程度因人而异。

- 卵巢病灶可形成内异囊肿，俗称巧克力囊肿；盆腔瘢痕可把组织粘连在一起。
- 一部分人会难以怀孕；慢性疼痛、性交痛和疲倦也会影响情绪、关系、上学和工作。
- 肠道、膀胱或输尿管受累会使治疗更复杂，因此持续排便排尿变化需告诉治疗团队。
text.en:
The main burden involves pain, local scarring and fertility effects, with substantial individual variation.

- Ovarian lesions can form endometriomas, sometimes called chocolate cysts; pelvic scarring can join tissues through adhesions.
- Some experience difficulty conceiving; chronic pain, painful sex and fatigue can also affect mood, relationships, education and work.
- Bowel, bladder or ureter involvement complicates management; persistent changes in passing stool or urine should be reported to the care team.

text.zh-CN:
目前没有可靠方法保证预防首次发生，重点是减少延误和长期影响。

- 把明显影响生活的痛经当作需要评估的症状，保留病程记录，有助于减少反复忍痛而延误处理。
- 已有病症时遵循治疗与随访计划，出现副作用及时调整；预防复发并不意味着长期忍受无法耐受的药物。
- 不要为了“治好异位症”而怀孕；是否生育应按自己的计划决定，疼痛和生育问题分别获得合适支持。
text.en:
There is no established way to guarantee primary prevention; priorities are reducing delay and long-term effects.

- Treat period pain that disrupts life as a symptom worth assessing and retain a history, helping avoid prolonged delays through simply tolerating it.
- With established disease, follow the treatment and review plan and report adverse effects for adjustment; relapse prevention does not mean persisting with intolerable medication.
- Do not pursue pregnancy as a cure; reproductive decisions should follow personal goals, with appropriate support for pain and fertility separately.

limitations.zh-CN: 各节保留来源定位和地区条件；编辑证据记录中的未完成项见来源与编辑信息。
limitations.en: Section sources and regional conditions are retained; unfinished evidence checks are recorded in editorial information.
